title: Discord bot crashes on login with Used disallowed intents or close code 4014
symptoms: Unhandled promise rejection on client.login() even with .catch() in discord.js 14.10+
cause: The bot asked for a privileged intent (GUILD_MEMBERS, GUILD_PRESENCES or MESSAGE_CONTENT) that is not switched on or not approved for the application. Discord closes the connection and reconnecting does not help.
fix: Switch the matching toggles on under Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents in the Developer Portal, or remove those intents from the client. Verified apps in 100 or more servers need Discord approval first.
apply: https://discord.com/developers/applications > your app > Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents > enable Server Members Intent / Message Content Intent > Save Changes
affected: Discord gateway, all library versions; discord.js 14.10.0 and later surfaces it as an uncaught rejection
